2. Develop pieces quickly, castle early, control the centre.
3. Check every move for opponent threats: hanging pieces, checks, forks, pins.
4. Prefer solid structures; avoid premature pawn grabs that open my king.
5. In endgames, activate the king and create passed pawns.
6. Calculate forcing lines (checks, captures, threats) before quiet moves.
7. Draw when clearly equal; play for win when ahead or when opponent errs.
